children.name: Title
children.characters: Rooted in the valley. Open to what comes next.

children.name: Heading
children.characters: A small place with a long memory

children.name: Lead
children.characters: Ravna Gora sits where the pine forest opens into pasture. For generations, people here have balanced care for the land with the practical work of keeping a village thriving.

children.name: Body
children.characters: This website brings local decisions, services and stories into one clear public place. Follow council work, find a family service, or understand how each block contributes to village life.
